# Driver bundle format

A driver is one JSON document (`*.falang-driver.json`, the shape `validate_driver`/`set_driver` take as `bundle`): `{ "formatVersion": 1, "config": <driver.config.json>, "files": { "<file name>": "<text>" } }`. Each file is at most 256 KiB, the whole bundle at most 1024 KiB. On disk a driver is the folder `<id>/` holding `driver.config.json` and every file of `files`.

## Fields

### bundle

| Field | Type | Required | Constraints |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `formatVersion` | `1` | yes |  |
| `config` | object | yes |  |
| `files` | map of string → string | yes |  |

### bundle.config

| Field | Type | Required | Constraints |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string | yes | pattern `^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*$` |
| `label` | string | yes |  |
| `version` | string | no |  |
| `includes` | array of string | yes | each item matches `^[\w.-]+$` |
| `sourceFiles` | array of string | yes | at least 1 item(s); each item matches `^[\w.-]+$` |
| `declarations` | array of string | yes | each item matches `^declare (function\|const) [A-Za-z_]\w*\b` |
| `actions` | array of object | yes | at least 1 item(s) |
| `device` | object | no |  |
| `notes` | string | no |  |
| `locales` | map of string → object | no |  |

| `fields` | array of object | yes |  |
| `codeTemplate` | string | yes |  |
| `resultType` | `"int"` \| `"float"` \| `"bool"` \| `"string"` | no |  |

## Rules the schema alone does not show

- `files` must contain exactly the names in `config.sourceFiles` ∪ `config.includes` — no more, no fewer; file names are flat (no `/`).
- A `${name}` in a `codeTemplate` or `device.setupTemplate` must be a declared field of that action/device. Values are substituted verbatim into C++; a `string` field is a TypeScript string expression.
- An action has at most one `new-variable` field, and `resultType` (`int` / `float` / `bool` / `string`) is set exactly when it has one. A `select` field needs `options`, whose `value`s are integer literals. `device.fields` cannot be `new-variable`.
- Every C function the templates call must be declared in `config.declarations` (`declare function name(arg: number): number;`) with a unique prefix: names are checked against built-ins and every other driver.
- `notes` (driver, action) is plain English for the LLM and the node-kinds catalog — always fill it in.
